request_text: Create an issue-tracker ticket scoping a published docsite for spec-kitty-open-packs that pulls content from the actual code structure (packs, validator), checksum-tagged for integrity. Launch research squads to investigate feasibility, blockers (missing SK functionality), and advise on docsite structure. Produce docs/research (Common Docs), docs/architecture with an adr subdirectory, open-packs tracker tickets, and cross-reference spec-kitty core tickets — no new core tickets without HiC approval.
